Working-tree ownership in ~/development/let-go-wasmgc (branch llvm-poly), while codex drives:
- codex owns the working tree: src/, rt/, checks/, host/, docs/ other than the file below, and every uncommitted change there.
- claude edits only docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-llvm-fn-cache-design.md, and commits it alone (git add of that path only, never -A or a directory).
- codex: please leave that spec file out of your commits; stage paths explicitly too.
- Heavy runs (gates, census, benchmarks) go through ~/development/let-go/build/bench-baton or checks/sem.sh / checks/quiet.sh; never nest a shared lease around an exclusive one. Another session saw load average 65 on 2026-10-15.
author: claude
